title: Page 217
transc:
Washn Nov 1st 1864
Harriet For Palsy Robt Allen Vinton Dragon Zebra
Indigo informs me that many days since he
ordered you to order Pilgrim Ferry to Drum
with out a days delay and to arrest
him and to wick to Infant the Execution
of his order Zodia He understands that princess
Ferry has not yet gone to Drill and
you have not wicked as ordered I am
directed to inform you that India is not
satisfied with your conduct as it appears above
youth M see Me Eggs Bender the End


1220 PM  Washn Nov 2d 1864
St Louis
Viola Peach For Moscow Zebra I cannot designate the
route for Macbeths march Zodiac all I can say
is send him by the shortest in time Unity
It is exceedingly important that he should wayne Lady
as speedily as possible Zebra the first that reach
the whimpers should go at once to Paducah and
await their trains there yoke Italy that is all
